docs.title: RubyMT4 SDK
docs.text: Welcome to the RubyMT4 SDK documentation. This gem provides an idiomatic Ruby interface connecting directly to MetaTrader 4 servers without requiring a local MT4 desktop terminal or Wine.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Pure Ruby Implementation: Zero native extensions or Wine overhead.
  • Block-Based Quote Streaming: Stream real-time ticks using standard Ruby blocks.
  • Full Trade Execution: Market orders, limit & stop orders, SL/TP trailing, and closing.
  • Account Monitoring: Live equity, margin, leverage, and trade history.

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
graph TD
    A[Ruby Application] -->|Socket I/O| B[MetaRPC::MT4::Client]
    B -->|Encrypted Protocol| C[MetaTrader 4 Server]
    C -->|Quotes Callback| B
    C -->|Order Confirmations| B
    B -->|Ruby Block Yield| A

docs.title: Quick Installation
docs.text:
Add to your Gemfile:

gem 'metarpc_mt4', git: 'https://github.com/MetaRPC/RubyMT4.git'

And run:

bundle install

See Getting Started to start trading.

docs.title: Connection & Authentication
docs.text:
Managing MT4 sessions with MetaRPC::MT4::Client.

require 'metarpc_mt4'

client = MetaRPC::MT4::Client.new('mt4.broker.com', 443)
client.connect(100234, 'password')

if client.connected?
  puts "Online and ready!"
end

client.disconnect

docs.title: Quickstart Example
docs.text:
require 'metarpc_mt4'

client = MetaRPC::MT4::Client.new('mt4.broker.com', 443)

puts 'Connecting...'
client.connect(100234, 'my_pass')
puts 'Connected!'

acc = client.account_info
puts "Balance: #{acc[:balance]} #{acc[:currency]}"

# Open 0.01 Buy
order = client.order_send(
  symbol: 'EURUSD',
  cmd: :buy,
  lots: 0.01,
  comment: 'Ruby Quickstart'
)

puts "Order executed! Ticket ##{order[:ticket]}"

docs.title: Quotes & Market Data
docs.text:
Streaming tick quotes:

client.subscribe_quotes(['EURUSD', 'GBPUSD']) do |quote|
  puts "[#{quote.symbol}] Bid: #{quote.bid} | Ask: #{quote.ask}"
end

docs.title: Trading & Orders
docs.text:
Opening, modifying, and closing orders.

# Open order
order = client.order_send(
  symbol: 'EURUSD',
  cmd: :buy,
  lots: 0.1,
  stop_loss: 1.0800,
  take_profit: 1.0950
)

# Modify order
client.order_modify(
  ticket: order[:ticket],
  stop_loss: 1.0820,
  take_profit: 1.0960
)

# Close order
client.order_close(
  ticket: order[:ticket],
  lots: 0.1
)
